description: This file contains core functions for handling and reading 'tree' objects in a Git repository, including tree traversal, comparison, parsing, and lookup.

methods.name: int read_tree_at(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,int depth,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Recursively reads a tree object and applies a callback function to each entry, handling submodules and directories.

methods.name: int read_tree(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Initiates reading a tree starting at the top level, using read_tree_at.

methods.name: int base_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Compares two filenames in a case-sensitive manner, taking into account directory modes.

methods.name: int df_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Similar to base_name_compare but treats directory and file entries as equal if they conflict.

methods.name: int name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,const char * name2,size_t len2)
methods.description: Basic comparison of two filenames with length awareness.

methods.name: struct:tree * lookup_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finds or creates a tree object in the repository by object ID.

methods.name: int parse_tree_buffer(struct tree * item,void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Parses a raw buffer into a tree object.

methods.name: int repo_parse_tree_gently(struct repository * r,struct tree * item,int quiet_on_missing)
methods.description: Reads and verifies a tree object from the object database, with an option to quietly fail if missing.

methods.name: void free_tree_buffer(struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Frees the buffer associated with a tree object.

methods.name: struct:tree * repo_parse_tree_indirect(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Peels an object ID to a tree object, parsing it as necessary.
